in_sanskrit.name: Zuala
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Star of the Night
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Zuala एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ratri', meaning night. Zuala is a name for a star that shines brightly in the night sky, bringing tranquility and peace to those who look upon it.
